PayrollOpeningBalance.title: Opening balance
PayrollOpeningBalance.description: The year-to-date figures an employee brings from the previous payroll package when an administration switches to humaniq during the year. The annual statement and the work-related costs assessment add them to humaniq's own payslips. One per employee, administration and year.
PayrollOpeningBalance.x-notes: payroll-period-edge-cases D5: imported with the library's mass import on the OpeningBalances page, no endpoint (ADR-022). PayrollOpeningBalanceUniqueGuard refuses a second balance for the same employeeId, administrationId and year.
